title: A 25-year-old just tripled his London chip startup to $3.3bn, betting against Nvidia and the shortage.
excerpt: London’s Olix raised $312M at $3.3bn to build optical AI chips that dodge the components in shortest supply. Backers include Arm and the UK government.
content_html:
A London startup two years old has just become one of Britain’s boldest bets against Nvidia. Olix has raised $312m and tripled its valuation to $3.3bn in six months. Its founder, James Dacombe, is 25. And its pitch has a timely twist: a chip that skips the very parts the rest of the industry is fighting over.

The New York firm Fundomo led the Series B, Sifted reported. Arm, the quant trading firm Hudson River Trading and Netflix co-founder Reed Hastings also took part. So did the UK government, through its Sovereign AI fund, which counts Olix as one of its first bets. The round values the company at more than triple its February mark of about $1bn.

Dacombe’s pitch is that the age of one chip doing everything is ending. The industry is “moving into a world of specialists,” he told the FT. He likens an AI data centre to a factory whose product is the token. Making one token takes hundreds of operations with different hardware needs, yet every stage runs on one general-purpose chip.

Olix wants to give each stage its own machine. Its X-1 platform spreads a model across several specialised chips, wired together by an optical network that moves data with light rather than copper. The first chip, DX-1, handles the stage where a model writes its output. For very large models, Olix claims it can run faster and on less power than a general-purpose part.

The timely part: it dodges the shortage

The detail that matters most right now is what Olix’s chips leave out. The DX-1 uses no high-bandwidth memory and no advanced packaging, the company says, holding a model in fast on-chip memory instead. Those happen to be the components in shortest supply, the squeeze now pushing up prices on everything from laptops to phones.

The pedigree around the founder is heavy for a company this young. Olix has put Nick McKeown, a Stanford professor who helped invent modern networking, on its board. Its new finance chief, Matt Briers, spent nine years as chief financial officer of Wise and took the fintech public. The firm now has more than 140 staff across the UK, US and Canada.

Still a bet, not a product

For all the momentum, Olix has not shipped a chip. It plans to finish its design later this year and reach its first customers in 2027, selling the silicon inside a full server rack. Only then will its headline performance claims be tested against real workloads, rather than a pitch deck.

It is also small next to its American rivals. Etched is valued at $10.3bn and SambaNova at around $11bn, and both dwarf Olix’s $3.3bn. The public markets are wary too, with chip stocks jittery over how much debt is funding the AI build-out.

Investors are betting the market is big enough to carry more than a few winners. AI chips are worth roughly $84bn this year and could approach $1tn early next decade, and money keeps pouring into AI hardware. For the UK, Olix is a rare shot at owning a slice of it. Whether the silicon delivers is the only number that will settle it.

content_html_zh:
一家成立两年的伦敦初创公司刚刚成为英国对英伟达最大胆的赌注之一。 Olix 已筹集 3.12 亿美元，六个月内估值增加两倍至 33 亿美元。 其创始人詹姆斯·达科姆 (James Dacombe) 现年 25 岁。 它的宣传有一个适时的转变：一款跳过了业界其他公司正在争夺的部件的芯片。

据 Sifted 报道，纽约公司 Fundomo 领投了 B 轮融资。 Arm、量化交易公司 Hudson River Trading 和 Netflix 联合创始人 Reed Hastings 也参与其中。 英国政府也通过其主权人工智能基金做出了同样的贡献，该基金将 Olix 视为其首批赌注之一。 该轮融资对该公司的估值约为 2 月份约 10 亿美元的三倍多。

Dacombe 的主张是，一块芯片包揽一切的时代即将结束。 他告诉英国《金融时报》，该行业正在“进入一个专家的世界”。 他将人工智能数据中心比作工厂，其产品就是代币。 制作一个代币需要数百次具有不同硬件需求的操作，但每个阶段都在一个通用芯片上运行。

Olix 希望为每个阶段提供自己的机器。 其 X-1 平台将模型扩展到多个专用芯片上，这些芯片通过光网络连接在一起，通过光而不是铜来传输数据。 第一个芯片 DX-1 负责处理模型写入输出的阶段。 对于非常大的模型，Olix 声称它比通用部件运行速度更快，功耗更低。

及时的部分：它避免了短缺

目前最重要的细节是 Olix 芯片遗漏的内容。 该公司表示，DX-1 没有使用高带宽内存，也没有先进的封装，而是将模型保存在快速片上内存中。 这些恰好是供应最短缺的组件，目前的短缺推高了从笔记本电脑到手机等各种产品的价格。

对于一家如此年轻的公司来说，创始人的血统很深厚。 Olix 已将帮助发明现代网络的斯坦福大学教授 Nick McKeown 纳入其董事会。 其新任财务总监马特·布里尔斯 (Matt Briers) 在 Wise 担任首席财务官九年，带领金融科技上市。 该公司目前在英国、美国和加拿大拥有 140 多名员工。

仍然是一个赌注，而不是一个产品

尽管势头强劲，但 Olix 尚未发货任何芯片。 它计划在今年晚些时候完成设计，并在 2027 年到达第一批客户，在完整的服务器机架内销售芯片。 只有这样，它的总体性能声明才会根据实际工作负载而不是宣传材料进行测试。

与美国竞争对手相比，它的规模也很小。 Etched 的估值为 103 亿美元，SambaNova 的估值约为 110 亿美元，两者都让 Olix 的 33 亿美元相形见绌。 公开市场也很谨慎，芯片股对有多少债务为人工智能建设提供资金感到紧张。

投资者押注市场足够大，足以带来不少赢家。 今年 AI 芯片的价值约为 840 亿美元，下个十年初期可能会接近 1 万亿美元，而且资金不断涌入 AI 硬件。 对于英国来说，奥利克斯是一个罕见的拥有分一杯羹的人。 芯片能否交付是解决这个问题的唯一数字。
